name: md-task
description: Markdown-first task management. Tasks-plugin compatible, no Obsidian lock-in.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @md-task/core && npm run build -w @md-task/app && npm run build -w @md-task/plugin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @md-task/core && npm run typecheck -w @md-task/app && npm run typecheck -w @md-task/plugin
